rows.behavior: kmctl doctor's antigravity.apm-hooks fails, naming .agents/hooks.json, that it is not a JSON object, and a fix to repair the file by hand and run kmctl plugin install --harness antigravity, when that file does not parse; it passes for a parsed file whose handlers do not run okf-stop-check.sh, even when the text mentions it elsewhere; and it still fails, naming kmctl plugin install --harness antigravity, for a handler that runs it.
rows.fails_when: an unparsable file passes or gets only the install fix, a mention outside a handler command fails the check, or an okf handler passes

rows.behavior: docs/reference/commands.md describes the unparsable-file case of antigravity.apm-hooks; the install how-to's sample doctor output includes an antigravity.apm-hooks line, and its copy of the install note names okf's Stop check as the CLI prints it.
rows.fails_when: the reference lacks the case, the sample output lacks the line, or the note differs from the CLI's
rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_doctor.py tests/test_antigravity.py -k apm_hooks_docs -q

rows.fails_when: uv run pytest or uv run pytest -m integration fails
rows.command: uv run pytest -q -m "not integration or integration"
